definition_en: An animal that is hunted and eaten by another animal.

definition_en: To clap your hands to show that you enjoyed something or approve of it.

definition_en: To burst or make a short, sharp sound, or to move quickly and suddenly.

example_en: You need to show some {{identification}} before you can board the plane.
example_vi: Bạn cần xuất trình giấy tờ tùy thân trước khi lên máy bay.

meaning_vi: sự loại trừ; sự bị gạt ra ngoài
definition_en: The act of not allowing someone or something to take part or be included.

definition_en: The amount that can be held in one hand, or a small number of people or things.

definition_en: To end something, especially an agreement or a process.

meaning_vi: trao quyền; giúp có đủ sức mạnh

definition_en: A narrow opening for putting something in, or a place in a schedule.

definition_en: To be one of the first people to develop or use a new idea or method.

example_en: The scientist helped to {{pioneer}} a new way of cleaning ocean water.

definition_en: A small amount of something that remains after the main part has gone.

definition_en: The decision about what illness a person has, based on signs and tests.
definition_vi: Kết luận về việc một người mắc bệnh gì, dựa trên các dấu hiệu và xét nghiệm.

meaning_vi: tiền đề; luận điểm xuất phát

definition_en: Completely and without any doubt.

definition_en: To manage the work of an organization, or to give medicine to someone.

definition_en: A special right or benefit that only some people have, or something you feel honored to do.
definition_vi: Một quyền lợi đặc biệt chỉ một số người có, hoặc điều bạn cảm thấy vinh dự khi được làm.

definition_en: To become smaller, weaker, or less important, or to make something so.

definition_en: Thinking carefully about other people and what they need, or showing serious thought.

definition_en: To be higher or greater than something, or to be at the highest position.
